panels.title: Operator view: who runs the stake, what is left to pay for votes, how each validator is doing
Validators at a glance
panels.description: One row per validator identity. Runs on host: the machine that runs that identity right now; it changes in a failover. Identity SOL pays the vote fees. Spend/day is net: vote fees minus block revenue. Days left = balance / spend; 9999 means the balance is not falling. Vote acct SOL is the commission earned and not yet withdrawn. Credits compares with the best validator. Skip 1h is the share of leader slots without a block.

targets.expr: max by (nodekey, node) (label_replace(solana_node_identity, "nodekey", "$1", "identity", "(.+)") and on (nodekey) group by (nodekey) (solana_validator_last_vote))
max by (nodekey) (label_replace(solana_account_balance, "votekey", "$1", "address", "(.+)") * on (votekey) group_left (nodekey) group by (votekey, nodekey) (solana_validator_last_vote))

panels.title: Failover pair: primary and hot spare
panels.description: Both hosts of the pair, whatever their role. Exactly one row may be ACTIVE. Ready to take over = healthy and at most 20 slots behind: for the standby this answers 'could I switch right now'. After a switch the two rows trade places.

targets.expr: max by (node) (solana_node_identity{node=~"validator2|spare"} and on (identity) label_replace(group by (nodekey) (solana_validator_last_vote), "identity", "$1", "nodekey", "(.+)")) or max by (node) (solana_node_identity{node=~"validator2|spare"}) * 0

max by (node) ((solana_node_is_healthy{node=~"validator2|spare"} == 1) and on (node) (solana_node_num_slots_behind{node=~"validator2|spare"} <= 20)) or max by (node) (solana_node_is_healthy{node=~"validator2|spare"}) * 0

panels.title: SLO: is each validator earning what its stake should earn? Targets: credits 99% of the best, leader slots 98%, voting time 99.9%
Credits vs the best validator, last hour
panels.description: The service level indicator. Target 99%.

panels.title: Credits vs the best validator, last 24 h
panels.description: What a delegator would see on a public explorer. Target 99%.

panels.title: Leader slots produced, last 24 h
panels.description: Target 98%.

panels.title: Time not delinquent, last 24 h
panels.description: Target 99.9%: 86 seconds a day.

panels.title: Error budget left, last 24 h: credits
panels.description: 100% = nothing lost, 0% = the allowed 1% is spent, negative = the target was missed.

panels.title: Error budget left, last 24 h: leader slots
panels.description: Budget: 2% of leader slots.

panels.title: Error budget left, last 24 h: voting time
panels.description: Budget: 0.1% of the time.

panels.title: Credits burn rate
panels.description: 1 = spending the budget exactly as fast as the target allows. Above 14.4 on 5m and 1h pages (p1); above 6 on 30m and 6h opens a ticket.

panels.title: Credits vs the best validator over time
panels.description: A failover or a restart shows as a dip in the 5m line; the 1h line shows what it cost.

panels.title: Layer 1: cluster. Is the chain moving and agreeing?
Cluster root slot
panels.description: Newest slot that can no longer be rolled back.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Counts alert instances, so one cause on four hosts and three volumes shows as twelve.

panels.title: Slots per second
panels.description: Flat at zero means the node stopped following the chain.

panels.title: Root and last vote of the cluster
panels.description: The gap between the two is how far finality trails the tip.

panels.title: Layer 2: validators. Are we voting and producing our leader slots?
Which host runs a voting identity
panels.description: One row per host. A failover shows as two rows changing colour at the same moment.

targets.expr: max by (node) (solana_node_identity{node=~"$node"} and on (identity) label_replace(group by (nodekey) (solana_validator_last_vote), "identity", "$1", "nodekey", "(.+)")) or max by (node) (solana_node_identity{node=~"$node"}) * 0

panels.title: Hosts per voting identity
panels.description: Must be 1. 2 pages at once (VotingIdentityOnTwoHosts); missing pages after 30 s.

panels.title: Vote lag behind the cluster (slots)
panels.description: ValidatorVoteLagging pages above 50.

targets.expr: max by (nodekey) (solana:validator_vote_lag:slots) * on (nodekey) group_left (node) max by (nodekey, node) (label_replace(solana_node_identity{node=~"$node"}, "nodekey", "$1", "identity", "(.+)") and on (nodekey) group by (nodekey) (solana_validator_last_vote{nodekey=~"$identity"}))

panels.title: Delinquent
panels.description: 1 = the cluster marks this validator as delinquent.

targets.expr: max by (nodekey) (solana_validator_delinquent) * on (nodekey) group_left (node) max by (nodekey, node) (label_replace(solana_node_identity{node=~"$node"}, "nodekey", "$1", "identity", "(.+)") and on (nodekey) group by (nodekey) (solana_validator_last_vote{nodekey=~"$identity"}))

panels.title: Skip rate per validator, last hour

targets.expr: max by (nodekey) (solana:validator_skip_rate:1h) * on (nodekey) group_left (node) max by (nodekey, node) (label_replace(solana_node_identity{node=~"$node"}, "nodekey", "$1", "identity", "(.+)") and on (nodekey) group by (nodekey) (solana_validator_last_vote{nodekey=~"$identity"}))

(sum by (nodekey, status) (rate(solana_validator_leader_slots_total[5m])) * 60) * on (nodekey) group_left (node) max by (nodekey, node) (label_replace(solana_node_identity{node=~"$node"}, "nodekey", "$1", "identity", "(.+)") and on (nodekey) group by (nodekey) (solana_validator_last_vote{nodekey=~"$identity"}))

panels.title: Vote credits, share of the best validator
panels.description: Voting late earns fewer credits without ever being delinquent.

targets.expr: max by (nodekey) (solana:validator_credits_ratio:10m) * on (nodekey) group_left (node) max by (nodekey, node) (label_replace(solana_node_identity{node=~"$node"}, "nodekey", "$1", "identity", "(.+)") and on (nodekey) group by (nodekey) (solana_validator_last_vote{nodekey=~"$identity"}))

panels.title: Vote credits earned this epoch
panels.description: Resets at every epoch boundary.

targets.expr: max by (nodekey) (solana_vote_credits_epoch) * on (nodekey) group_left (node) max by (nodekey, node) (label_replace(solana_node_identity{node=~"$node"}, "nodekey", "$1", "identity", "(.+)") and on (nodekey) group by (nodekey) (solana_validator_last_vote{nodekey=~"$identity"}))

panels.title: Stake (SOL)
panels.description: Decides the share of leader slots.

targets.expr: max by (nodekey) (solana_validator_active_stake) * on (nodekey) group_left (node) max by (nodekey, node) (label_replace(solana_node_identity{node=~"$node"}, "nodekey", "$1", "identity", "(.+)") and on (nodekey) group by (nodekey) (solana_validator_last_vote{nodekey=~"$identity"}))

panels.title: Stake share of the cluster
panels.description: The share decides the leader slots. ValidatorStakeShareDropped opens a ticket.

targets.expr: max by (nodekey) (solana:validator_stake_share:ratio) * on (nodekey) group_left (node) max by (nodekey, node) (label_replace(solana_node_identity{node=~"$node"}, "nodekey", "$1", "identity", "(.+)") and on (nodekey) group by (nodekey) (solana_validator_last_vote{nodekey=~"$identity"}))

max by (nodekey) (solana_validator_root_slot) * on (nodekey) group_left (node) max by (nodekey, node) (label_replace(solana_node_identity{node=~"$node"}, "nodekey", "$1", "identity", "(.+)") and on (nodekey) group by (nodekey) (solana_validator_last_vote{nodekey=~"$identity"}))

panels.title: Layer 3: funds. Can we still pay for votes?
Identity SOL
panels.description: Every vote is paid from this account.

targets.expr: max by (nodekey) (label_replace(solana:identity_balance:sol, "nodekey", "$1", "address", "(.+)")) * on (nodekey) group_left (node) max by (nodekey, node) (label_replace(solana_node_identity{node=~"$node"}, "nodekey", "$1", "identity", "(.+)") and on (nodekey) group by (nodekey) (solana_validator_last_vote{nodekey=~"$identity"}))

panels.title: SOL spent per hour
panels.description: Positive = the balance is falling. Balance divided by this is the hours left.

targets.expr: max by (nodekey) (label_replace(-delta(solana:identity_balance:sol[1h]), "nodekey", "$1", "address", "(.+)")) * on (nodekey) group_left (node) max by (nodekey, node) (label_replace(solana_node_identity{node=~"$node"}, "nodekey", "$1", "identity", "(.+)") and on (nodekey) group by (nodekey) (solana_validator_last_vote{nodekey=~"$identity"}))
